_comment_header: grandMA2 onPC OSC Configuration. Verify all settings against your console in Setup -> Network -> OSC.

network._osc_receive_port_comment: Port grandMA2 listens on for incoming OSC commands. Default: 8000. Verify in console: Setup -> Network -> OSC -> In Port
network._osc_send_port_comment: Port on mobile device to receive grandMA2 feedback/echo. Default: 8001. Verify in console: Setup -> Network -> OSC -> Out Port

address_patterns._prefix_comment: OSC Prefix configured in grandMA2 (Setup -> Network -> OSC -> Prefix). Can be empty '' or '/gma2'. Verify in console.
address_patterns._cmd_address_comment: Default address for grandMA2 command line strings. grandMA2 executes string argument sent to this address.
address_patterns._fader_address_comment: Alternative direct OSC fader address: e.g. /gma2/fader/1/1 with float 0.0-1.0. Also supports cmd string: 'Fader {exec} At {val}'
address_patterns._master_fader_comment: Grand master level fader address or cmd 'SpecialMaster 2.1 At {val}'
address_patterns._feedback_exec_comment: OSC feedback received from grandMA2 when an executor changes state

syntax_rules._at_symbol_comment: Use '@' or 'At' based on grandMA2 version syntax and command preference
syntax_rules._fader_rate_limit_comment: Maximum fader updates per second (30 Hz = ~33ms) to prevent UDP flood buffer overflow
